prompt: Colleagues keep mispronouncing a new team member's name in meetings, even after that person has politely corrected them once. What response best helps?

options.text: Use the shortened nickname others have started using instead
Correct them loudly every single time, even mid-sentence
Make a point of saying the name correctly yourself, and gently remind others of the right pronunciation when it slips
Say nothing, since pronunciation is a small thing

explanation: Modelling the correct name and offering gentle reminders normalises getting it right, which matters more than it may seem to the person named.
